name: Jongno Day Walk – Cheong Wa Dae → Bukchon → Ikseon-dong → Insadong → Ssamziegil
desc: Half-day walk through Jongno, Seoul, reconstructed from a map-narrated YouTube itinerary. Street geometry from OpenStreetMap via a pedestrian router. Bus from Dongdaemun to Cheong Wa Dae is not part of the track. Route ends at Ssamziegil on Insadong-gil.

segments.label: Cheong Wa Dae gate → Cheongwadae-ro → Samcheong-ro → Samcheong police box
Side alley Bukchon-ro 5ga-gil → Pungnyeon Ssalnongsan → Jeongdok Library
Up to Bukchon Hanok Village (Gahoe-dong 31, Bukchon-ro 12-gil) and back down Bukchon-ro to Anguk Station
Anguk → Samil-daero → Hyundai Trevian → Ikseon-dong hanok street → grill alley → Jongno 3-ga
Jongno 3-ga → Jongno → Tapgol Park → Insadong-gil → Ssamziegil

waypoints.name: 1. Start – Cheong Wa Dae (Blue House) main gate
waypoints.desc: Take a bus from Dongdaemun in the morning (reservation needed for Cheong Wa Dae; book online first). Tour quickly, then walk east along Cheongwadae-ro toward Samcheong-dong.
waypoints.label: Start

waypoints.name: 2. Samcheong Police Box – turn into the side alley
waypoints.desc: Three-storey police box on Samcheong-ro. Emart24 with 2F seating is just before it if you need a break. Turn into the alley beside it (Bukchon-ro 5ga-gil).
waypoints.label: Samcheong police box

waypoints.name: 3. Pungnyeon Ssalnongsan – tteokbokki & rice-cake skewers
waypoints.desc: Old rice shop turned snack bar (Bukchon-ro 5ga-gil 32). Grab one tteok skewer; keep meals light, there is food all day.
waypoints.label: Tteokbokki stop

waypoints.name: 4. Jeongdok Library corner – cafés & galleries
waypoints.desc: The lane continues down to Anguk Station exit 1. For the hanok village, go up first (next two pins) and come back down.
waypoints.label: Jeongdok Library

waypoints.name: 5. Bukchon Hanok Village – Gahoe-dong 31 alley
waypoints.desc: Classic hanok alley (Bukchon 4th & 7th viewpoints). Hanbok photo spot.
waypoints.label: Bukchon hanok alley

waypoints.name: 6. Bukchon Hanok Village viewpoint (Bukchon-ro 12-gil)
waypoints.desc: Turn around here and walk back down Bukchon-ro to Anguk Station.
waypoints.label: Bukchon viewpoint

waypoints.name: 7. Anguk Station (exit 1) – turn right
waypoints.desc: Head east along Yulgok-ro toward the Jongno fire station, then down Samil-daero.
waypoints.label: Anguk Station

waypoints.name: 8. Hyundai Trevian apartments – entrance to Ikseon-dong
waypoints.desc: Find this building, then take the lane beside it into the hanok street.
waypoints.label: Ikseon-dong entrance

waypoints.name: 9. Ikseon-dong Hanok Street
waypoints.desc: Single-storey hanok converted into cafés and shops. For a proper meal use the grill alley (Donhwamun-ro 11ga-gil) where meat is cooked on the street.
waypoints.label: Ikseon-dong

waypoints.name: 10. Jongno 3-ga Station – pojangmacha street (night only)
waypoints.desc: After dark one lane is closed and fills with street-food tents. Daytime: nothing here, so move on quickly.
waypoints.label: Jongno 3-ga tents

waypoints.name: 11. Tapgol Park (Samilmun Gate)
waypoints.desc: Pass the park heading west along Jongno.
waypoints.label: Tapgol Park

waypoints.name: 13. End – Ssamziegil
waypoints.desc: Spiral-ramp shopping building on Insadong-gil. Finish here; Anguk Station (line 3) is 250 m north.
waypoints.label: End
